# LEO SNOW

> LEO SNOW — "Ghana Boy With A Different Flow" and "The Storm From Africa" — is an Afrobeats artist from Ghana blending afrobeats, alté and street soul into one cold wave.

The official site is a one-page experience: a cinematic hero, the artist's story, a showcase room of visual moments, music releases with streaming links, tour events with ticket and calendar links, and a booking contact form. Content is managed live through a connected Supabase backend.

## Sections

- [Home](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/): full-screen hero with the LEO SNOW brand, tagline "The Storm From Africa — the global takeover begins here", and a Stream Latest button.
- [Music](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/#music): releases (singles, EPs, mixtapes) with cover art and direct links to streaming platforms (Spotify, Audiomack, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Boomplay, Deezer).
- [Videos](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/#videos): official music videos embedded from YouTube.
- [Events](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/#shows): upcoming shows with dates, cities, ticket links and add-to-calendar reminders.
- [About](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/#about): the artist's story and a showcase room of images, each with its own story.
- [Booking](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/#contact): bookings and inquiries via email and a direct message form.

## Contact

- Bookings: leosnowbookings@gmail.com
- Streaming: available on YouTube, SoundCloud, Apple Music and BandCamp
